description: Turn ideas into durable specs, then implement them with TDD and independent code review.

interface.shortDescription: Brainstorm specs and implement them with TDD.
interface.longDescription: My Skills provides a two-stage workflow: exhaustively clarify an idea into a reusable spec, then implement that spec with test-driven development and independent review.
